## What this changes

Explain the learning improvement or the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue when applicable.

## Sources and rights

List new or adapted resources, datasets, code, and their licenses. Describe substantial AI assistance, or write "None".

## Validation

List exact commands and outcomes, relevant comparisons, and optional paths that were not tested. For documentation-only changes, describe link and content checks.

## Limitations and costs

Note runtime, hardware, model/service requirements, paid operations, and known limitations where applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md, CONTRIBUTOR_AGREEMENT.md, and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
- [ ] The applicable contribution license is established and I have the right to submit this work under it; otherwise this PR remains a draft.
- [ ] Each contribution commit has the contributor's own DCO sign-off.
- [ ] Sources and required notices are included for reused material.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; untested paths are explicitly listed.
- [ ] Notebook outputs and execution counts are cleared where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, downloaded corpora, or unrelated generated files are included.
- [ ] Evaluation uses the documented split and full candidate corpus, or explains a justified exception.
- [ ] README links and affected setup/data/report documentation are updated where applicable.
